title: How WSI Scaled Operations
summary: Learn how WSI scaled operations through process improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies that supported business growth
body_markdown:
#### **Executive Summary**


When[WSI](https://www.wsinc.com/) , a privately held 3PL warehousing and shipping company, faced mounting invoice backlogs and an unsustainable manual proof of delivery (POD) collection process, we provided an integrated solution built on[TextLocate](https://www.textlocate.com/) and Triumph’s NextGen Audit. By embedding automated document capture and invoice auditing directly into its TMS, WSI eliminated end-of-month scrambles, reduced operational overhead, and built a back-office capable of supporting ten-times growth, all managed by one person.


#### **Client Background**


WSI’s a rapidly growing freight brokerage that prioritizes smart operations over headcount. Leadership has consistently embraced automation as a core strategy, believing efficient systems drive sustainable growth. With year-over-year growth trending at two times and accelerating toward four times, WSI needed a back-office infrastructure that could scale without adding cost.


#### **The Challenge**


As WSI’s load volumes climbed, a critical bottleneck emerged: POD collection. Every delivered load required a POD before WSI could invoice a customer and before it could pay a carrier. In WSI’s previous workflow, carrier sales reps were responsible for manually requesting those documents after each delivery. The results were predictable and costly.


*Dave Stone, Senior Director, Freight Brokerage at WSI described the situation: “You end up with a whole bunch of loads at the end of the week,*


*the end of the month that can’t be invoiced out.”*


**Payment Management Obstacles:**


- Carrier sales reps moved away from their core work of moving freight to chase paperwork.
- PODs frequently went uncollected, creating end-of-month invoice backlogs that disrupted cash flow.
- Accounting staff spent hours pursuing carriers via emails, phone calls, and payment threats.


**Invoicing Process Inefficiencies:**


- Invoicing was delayed by days, weeks, or even months after delivery.
- Inconsistent POD collection led to a two-tiered billing process, where some customers were invoiced without PODs while others with strict requirements created additional complexity.
- Delayed invoicing strained customer relationships and created friction on both sides of the business.


#### **The Solution**


- TextLocate automatically requests PODs via SMS from drivers and feeds them directly to Triumph Audit who then feeds them into the TMS, so no manual requests or touchpoints are required.
- The only carrier interaction required is the standard coverage conversation, gathering phone numbers, and driver information.
- Triumph’s NextGen Audit receives captured documents and audits carrier invoices with high auto-approval rates and minimal exceptions.
- The integration works entirely in the background and requires no changes to existing staff workflows.
- Every customer now receives a POD attached to every invoice as standard practice, eliminating inconsistency and inbound document requests.


#### **Results & Impact**


**Quantitative Results:**


- One team member now manages the entire audit box and processes all carrier invoices and PODs.
- WSI captures PODs continuously throughout the month, bringing invoicing into the correct billing window and accelerating cash flow.
- High auto-approval rates with minimal exceptions occur across all carrier invoices.
- WSI reinvested operational savings into revenue-generating activities, finding carriers, and onboarding new customers.


**Qualitative Benefits:**


- Improved carrier and factor confidence in payment processes
- Enhanced transparency across complex agency operations
- Automated what was previously a complex third-party invoicing workflow
- Reduced friction stemming from a complex and growing enterprise tech stack
